AdminSchema.description: A module's declared admin surface: which entities it exposes for management.

AdminSurface.description:
A module's admin surface.

`Schema` is implemented today. Custom surface variants are data contracts
only until the Runtime Console implements their renderers/policies.

oneOf.description: Schema-driven CRUD: console renders a generic UI from this declaration.
Host-rendered custom UI built from trusted Runtime Console components.
Module-owned UI embedded behind a sandbox boundary.

fields.description: Ordered field descriptors driving list columns / detail rows.

label.description: Human label for the console, e.g. "Users".

name.description: Stable entity key, unique within the module, e.g. "users".

read_capability.description:
Capability required to read this entity. Declared now; gated only
coarsely (AdminActor) this step. Fine-grained RBAC is a later spec.

event_name.description:
Stable event name consumed from `platform.outbox`, e.g.
`identity.user_registered.v1`.

name.description: Stable handler name used by Service Providers as the invoke path.

field_type.description: Rendering hint for the console's display layer.

name.description: Key in the record's JSON object, e.g. "email".

nullable.description: Whether the value may be null/absent.

FieldType.description: Minimal field-type vocabulary. `Json` is the catch-all so any field renders.

capability.description:
Optional capability required before a future host proxy exposes this
route. No enforcement exists until the proxy protocol is implemented.

display_name.description: Compact label used when this route appears as a runtime story node.

story_title.description: Optional story title for direct requests to this route.

ModuleManifest.description:
The serializable metadata a module exposes. Runtime config is deliberately
NOT here — it stays an internal `&'static` field on [`crate::Module`]
because the config registry needs the real (non-serde) `RuntimeConfigType`
to validate. Only round-trippable fields belong here.

admin.description:
Admin surface: `Some(AdminSurface::Schema(_))` for schema-driven CRUD,
future custom surfaces for richer module admin UI, or `None` for modules
with no admin surface (e.g. notifications).

capabilities.description: RESERVED SEAM — capabilities the module declares (perms/tenancy).

console.description: Declared Runtime Console surfaces provided by trusted frontend packages.

console_contributions.description: Declared Runtime Console slot contributions attached to host or module-owned surfaces.

console_slots.description: Declared Runtime Console extension slots owned by host or module surfaces.

events.description:
Declared event subscriptions. These entries are manifest data only;
source bindings decide how to register executable behavior.

http_routes.description:
Declared module-owned HTTP routes. These are metadata only until a
loading-source-specific mount/proxy protocol exists.

lifecycle.description:
Declared lifecycle work. The host validates and schedules these entries;
modules do not receive arbitrary startup callbacks.

requires.description: Other Modules required by this business capability.

runtime.description:
Declared runtime behavior. These entries are manifest data only; source
bindings decide how to register executable behavior.

input_schema.description: Optional schema identifier for the function input payload.

queue.description: Queue name the host should use when registering the function.

retry_policy.description:
Optional retry policy requested by the module. The host still owns
enforcement and may clamp values when behavior registration is added.

version.description: Version for the declared function contract.

workflows.description:
Engine-neutral Durable Workflow definitions owned by this Module.
Autonomous Service composition decides how to execute them; Host-managed
Provider and Runtime Function behavior does not consume this metadata.

function_name.description: Runtime function enqueued when this schedule is due.

name.description: Stable schedule name scoped to the owning module.

completionContract.description: Versioned Event Contract that confirms the remote business effect was reversed.

contract.description: Versioned Event Contract used to request the compensation effect.

name.description: Stable compensation behavior identity within this Workflow Definition.

order.description: Explicit deterministic execution order. Lower values execute first.

name.description: Stable workflow name within the owning Module.

owner.description: Stable Module identity that owns the workflow behavior.

steps.description: Ordered step metadata. Position in this vector is contract-significant.

version.description: Definition version pinned by every started instance.

delaysMs.description: Delay before attempts 2..N. The length must equal `max_attempts` - 1.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts including the original execution.

compensation.description:
Optional compensation for the completed business effect produced by
this step. The explicit order is evaluated across all completed effects
when compensation is selected; it is independent from completion time.

retryPolicy.description:
Optional durable retry schedule. `max_attempts` includes the original
attempt, while each delay schedules the following attempt.

timeoutMs.description: Optional durable timeout applied independently to every attempt.
